prompt:
Presentation Outline Generator
Generate a structured presentation outline or plan based on provided video transcripts or visual notes regarding scientific studies.
Markdown with bold headers for sections (e.g., Title, Introduction, Methodology, Results, Conclusion) and bullet points for content details.
Extract specific study details (name, method, sample size, error reduction percentage) from the input. Include standard academic presentation sections such as Introduction, Methodology, Results, Discussion, and Conclusion. Add sections for References and Future Directions/Work where appropriate. Maintain a professional and objective tone.
The input consists of short summaries of scientific experiments, specifically focusing on sensor stability and cooling methods (Vela/Nera series studies). The output is intended to help users structure a presentation based on these findings.
